messages:
Mia: quick async check — where are we on H100 procurement ETA, rack power/PDUs, and whether staging can accept 8 nodes next week? need clear owners for manifest creation + canary smoke.

Kevin: procurement update — vendor confirmed 24x H100s, ship ETA end of day next Friday (PO#4523). still waiting the final shipping manifest scan. i can own creating the reservation manifest when docs arrive. :white_check_mark: cc @Ashley for rack power scheduling.

Ashley: rack power update — data center confirmed 2x 40A PDUs per rack. breakers are available but we need a scheduled window for install (they asked for a 2-hour blackout). will put a diagram in the ops share. link: https://drive.redwood/power-diagrams/staging-rack-4

Dan: staging note — we can accept 4 nodes on Wed (18:00 UTC) and the remaining 4 on Fri (03:00 UTC) assuming networking is staged. need reservation window and IP pools. also need runtime owner for canary smoke tests.

infra-bot: IP pool status — available pools: 10.40.0.0/21 (staging), 10.48.0.0/22 (qa). reserving 10.40.0.0-10.40.0.31 for canary group per request.

Kevin: canary smoke owner? i can run hardware-level checks + image deploys. need runtime health endpoints from @Dan (/health, /metrics) and a sample token for pulls.

Dan: on it. health endpoints are: GET /health -> 200, GET /v1/kv/status -> JSON. sample curl for smoke:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SAMPLE_TOKEN" https://staging.runtime.redwood/v1/models/health
```
will put token in vault and share access.

Mia: timeline proposal:
- Tue: finalize PO scan and shipping docs (Kevin)
- Wed evening: stage networking + 4 nodes (Ashley/Dan)
- Thu morning: breaker window and PDUs install (Ashley)
- Fri early: remaining 4 nodes + canary deploy (Kevin/Dan)
- Fri afternoon: smoke results + rollback plan (SRE + Modeling-Team)
Please confirm or flag blockers.

Ashley: confirmed breaker window Thu 08:00-10:00 PDT. i'll book DC ops and post the work order id.

sre-oncall: heads up — please add the capacity reservation to tracker (INF-789) and attach the canary test checklist before deploy. oncall will monitor metrics and page at any regression beyond the standard thresholds.

Kevin: will add INF-789 entry and link the reservation manifest. also, fallback plan if H100s are delayed: can we fall back to A100s with quantized images? @Modeling-Team can you validate perf/regression tolerance?

Modeling-Team: quick reply — A100 quantized path is workable for now but expect 1.5x slower 99p latency for long sequences; i'll run a short eval and post numbers by Thu EOD.

Dan: network checklist for staging deploy (short):
- allocate IPs from 10.40.0.0/21
- create veth pairs and overlay subnets
- update LB config to include new node IDs
- ensure KV cache warmup script runs on first boot
I'll paste the k8s manifest snippet when Kevin has the node hostnames.

Kevin: PHASED manifest (draft) —
```
nodes:
  - name: staging-canary-01
    hw: h100-80gb
    rack: r4
  - name: staging-canary-02
    hw: h100-80gb
    rack: r4
# (omitted rest until PO scanned)
```
I'll update names after the shipping scan.

Mia: perfect. owners summary: Kevin (procurement + manifest), Ashley (rack power + DC ops), Dan (runtime + networking + smoke hooks), Modeling-Team (fallback perf eval), SRE (monitor + rollback). i'll keep this thread as the single source of truth and ping if anything changes. thanks all :tada:

Ashley: noted, will post work order id in here when scheduled.

Kevin: will upload PO scan to the ops folder as soon as it arrives and tag the manifest.

infra-bot: reminder — please follow the reservation template: https://confluence/redwood/reservation-template (fields: PO, manifest, breaker-window, ip-pool, rollback-plan).

Mia: last ask — if anyone expects stakeholder updates, i'll draft a short status note for the weekly capacity sync. otherwise i'll send a 1-line update Thu after breaker window.

Dan: +1, thanks.

sre-oncall: i'll be on watch Fri during the canary deploy window. ping me if you want me in the exec channel for live updates.
